posts.description: Five Nines When I was a teenager in the late 80s I worked as a gopher (As in: Hey kid, go for something I want; a less fancy name for Intern) for the company my Dad worked at. posts.title: Python Requests proxy all protocols through single URL
posts.description: The Python Requests library requires you to specify multiple proxy URLs per protocol, like this: import requests proxies = { 'http': 'http://10.10.1.10:3128', 'https': 'http://10.10.1.10:1080', } requests.get('http://example.org', proxies=proxies) The annoying thing is if you leave off either protocol, it does not error - it just doesn't proxy that traffic.
